name: sqlite-catalog-contracts-history-review
goal: SQLite catalog units declare accurate readable contracts, and history-index source changes retain committed relocation review evidence.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The feature commit adds six derived SQLite/catalog function manifests and changes two previously moved history implementations. Expected behavior is declared, readable unit contracts and committed review entries tied to each changed definition while original move hashes remain intact.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The generic contract test reports missing descriptions but does not pin the six new catalog units as a group; the existing service index test detects stale definitions but the review ledger guard does not require a review when one is absent. Added focused metadata and review-ledger assertions while keeping shared test support unchanged.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed red checkpoint 96cdc762b: the unchanged unit-index guard reports two moved-source definition gaps, the new review test reports the missing buildHistory review, and the SQLite contract checks report 32 metadata gaps. The isolated Vitest command installs dependencies from the committed lockfile first.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
